touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Stoak qualifies as a local detour through Standing cross in St Lawrence's churchyard, Stoak and CHURCH OF ST LAWRENCE. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Stoak: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Stoak offers Standing cross in St Lawrence's churchyard, Stoak, CHURCH OF ST LAWRENCE, Stoak Nature Park within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Standing cross in St Lawrence's churchyard, Stoak
